_comment: Each entry names a registered datrix.languages target, a documented
construct kind (endpoint, entity, field, enum_value, struct_field,
function), and a surface (published, source) whose emitted artifact does
not yet carry the author's DSL comment text -- with a written reason.
A realization change removes its own entry; the gate fails loud if an
exempted cell starts passing without its entry being removed (a stale
exemption). The list is EMPTY: every registered target realizes every construct kind
on both surfaces. The three entity/published entries this file used to
carry claimed no target defined a published landing site for entity-level
documentation; each target now does -- python a Pydantic model docstring,
typescript @ApiSchema, java a class-level @Schema, dotnet a class-level
